description: FlyCapture is FLIR's (formerly Point Grey Research's) SDK for configuring and capturing images from industrial and scientific machine-vision cameras over USB, FireWire, and GigE interfaces. This JavaCPP Presets module generates Java bindings for the native FlyCapture2 C/C++ library, letting JVM applications control cameras and grab image streams directly through JNI without writing custom native-interop code.
